Support incident response activities including containment, eradication, and recovery. - Conduct phishing email investigations including header analysis, URL reputation checks, and payload and attachment analysis. - Analyze malware behavior using static and basic dynamic analysis. - Extract and validate IOCs. - Conduct proactive threat hunting exercises. - Investigate DDoS alerts and network-based attacks. - Monitor endpoint and network security events. - Assist in SIEM rule tuning and use case optimization. - Perform EDR/XDR investigations and endpoint containment actions. - Update incident response playbooks and operational SOPs. - Coordinate with infrastructure, network, and application teams. - Prepare incident reports and RCA documentation. - Support and mentor junior SOC analysts. --- **Requirements** - Manage SIEM tools such as QRadar, Splunk, or Microsoft Sentinel. - Utilize Endpoint Security tools like EDR/XDR and Antivirus Solutions. - Operate WAF tools such as Imperva or Equivalent. - Employ Proxy Security tools like Symantec Proxy, Forcepoint. - Use Email Security tools such as Symantec Email Security, Trellix EX, Microsoft Defender for O365. - Apply Incident Management skills including Alert Monitoring, Triage & Escalation. - Leverage Threat Intelligence skills including IOC Validation, MITRE ATT&CK Basics. - Perform Log Analysis across Windows, Linux, Firewall, Proxy, EDR Logs. - Understand Network Security concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, HTTPS. - Apply Security Fundamentals including Cyber Security Concepts, Attack Lifecycle. - Have 2–6 years of SOC Monitoring and Security Operations experience. - Possess hands-on experience with SIEM tools. - Have knowledge of phishing analysis, malware investigation, and incident handling. - Understand networking protocols and security concepts. - Demonstrate strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. - Exhibit excellent communication and documentation abilities. - Be willing to work in a 24×7 rotational shift environment. --- **What We Offer** No information available.
